label: Lance
note: MH4U endgame Lance is primarily an evade-lance build: Honed Blade (Attack Up (L) + Sharpness +1), Challenger +2 (+25 true raw and +20% affinity while the monster is enraged), and Evasion +3, with Razor Sharp as the usual fourth skill when slots allow; fitting all four is unrealistic without a god charm or relic gear. The guard alternative runs Honed Blade, Razor Sharp, Guard +2, and Weakness Exploit. This preset captures only Honed Blade's permanent +20 true raw and Sharpness +1; Challenger +2's conditional buff, Evasion +3, Razor Sharp, Guard +2, Guard Up, Weakness Exploit, Evade Extender, and Critical Eye are unmodeled, and Element Atk Up is not assumed. Sharpness uses MH4U's 1.05 green / 1.20 blue / 1.32 white / 1.45 purple table.
